tools.name: tdd_meta
tools.description: What The Dutch Directory covers: listing counts by type, the Verified Pro count, doctrine and endpoint URLs. Call it when you need to know the scope of the directory before searching.

tools.name: tdd_search
tools.description: Search every way to learn Dutch: schools, universities, apps, podcasts, exams and online tutors. Use it when someone asks where or how to learn Dutch. Filters: city (Dutch or Flemish, e.g. Utrecht, Den Haag, Antwerpen), type, goal (e.g. inburgering, NT2, business, conversation), cefr, online, verifi

tools.name: tdd_shortlist
tools.description: A short list of the best-fit options for a city and goal, ranked by editorial fit score (not paid). Use it when someone wants a few recommendations rather than every option. A Dutch Fluency item always comes with independent alternatives.

tools.name: tdd_tutors
tools.description: Online Dutch tutors from italki, Preply, Verbling, LanguaTalk, Verbalplanet, Classgap and Superprof, Verified Pros (3,000+ lessons and a 4.9+ rating) first. Use it for private lessons, conversation practice or a tutor on a schedule; filter by platform or free text.

tools.name: tdd_compare
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of two schools, apps or tutors by slug, with a plain-language verdict. Use it after a search or shortlist when someone is choosing between two.

tools.name: tdd_path
tools.description: A week-by-week study path that points to real courses, tutors, apps and trials for a city, goal, current level, weekly hours and deadline. Use it when someone asks how to get from one level to another or how to prepare for an exam. Not a progress tracker; practice links to Dutch Fluency always come

tools.name: tdd_stats
tools.description: Live market numbers: listing counts by type, Verified Pro rates and median tutor prices. Use it for questions about the Dutch-learning market as a whole.

tools.name: tdd_graph
tools.description: Snapshot of the Dutch Learning Graph: providers, exams and goals and how they connect. slim=true returns counts and types only. Use it for data or research tasks, not for recommendations.

tools.name: tdd_move_plan
tools.description: Works backward from an arrival, inburgering or exam date to what to start when: courses, exam booking and tutor hours. Use it when someone has a fixed date.

tools.name: tdd_employer_budget
tools.description: Planning ranges (not a quote) for Dutch training for a team, from headcount, months, track and cities. Use it for HR or employer questions about cost.

tools.name: tdd_city_gaps
tools.description: Which provider types a Dutch or Flemish city lacks in the index, for example no university course. Use it to explain when to look online or in a nearby city.

tools.name: tdd_death_watch
tools.description: Data-quality signals in the index: stub names and missing prices or lesson counts. Scrape health, not claims about providers. Use it only for maintenance or data questions.

tools.name: tdd_conflict_ledger
tools.description: The public policy for when Dutch Fluency products appear in results and how independent alternatives are guaranteed. Use it when someone asks whether the directory is independent.

tools.name: tdd_evidence_pack
tools.description: A shareable, independent study plan (name, city, goal, weeks) that a learner can show an employer or attach to paperwork. Not legal advice.

tools.name: tdd_abroad
tools.description: Dutch courses, university Dutch departments, CNaVT exam centres and Dutch schools for children near a capital city (within 40 km), with the nearest option when nothing is local. Also says where the basic civic integration exam abroad (inburgering, level A1) is taken for a country: the Dutch embassy
